physicalNotes: No radius or mass of the Milky Way is recorded: it is an extended galaxy seen from inside. Its page is centred on a star, and its package frames the view with a sphere of the nominal solar radius, 695,700 km (IAU 2015 Resolution B3), a presentation value, not an extent of the galaxy; the drawn galaxy is the Milky Way volume bank (src/objects/milky-way-volume).

sources.position: The Galactic centre, taken as the position of Sagittarius A*: SIMBAD NAME Sgr A* (ICRS; coordinate reference 2011AJ....142...35P, Petrov et al. 2011, VLBA): https://simbad.cds.unistra.fr/simbad/sim-id?Ident=Sgr+A* (this repository's sgr-a-star.json).
sources.distance: GRAVITY Collaboration (2022, A&A 657, L12; arXiv:2112.07478), Table 1, four-star fit: R0 = 8277 +/- 9 pc.
sources.properMotion: Zero: the galaxy is held at its centre's catalogued position; no motion across the sky is applied.
sources.radialVelocity: Zero: the galaxy is held at its centre's distance.
